headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.0-modder.25
summary: Add mods straight from a MediaFire link: paste the link in the Add Mod dialog and the launcher downloads the file and imports it into your mod list, no extra apps or manual copying.

items.text: New Import from MediaFire option in the Add Mod dialog: paste a mediafire.com link, the launcher grabs the direct download and imports the mod for the selected Minecraft version.
Deleted or blocked MediaFire files are rejected with a clear message, and mods built for a different Minecraft version trigger the same compatibility warning as GitHub imports.
